HasExtraCardText.rationale: Bound.cs:8 declares `HasExtraCardText => true`, which only unlocks `AfflictionModel.DynamicExtraCardText` (AfflictionModel.cs:44-54), a `LocString` fed to the card-overlay UI — no game-state reader anywhere. `BoundAffliction` (afflictions.py) carries no such concept at all; presentation-only, same disposition as enchantment/adroit's HasExtraCardText waiver.

guards.what: Bound.cs declares no other override — ALL of the affliction's real behavior (trigger, budget, once-per-turn play gate, decay) lives in ChainsOfBindingPower, not on the AfflictionModel itself. Recording the split and where it lands, per the brief's request for trigger/ordering/stacking/decay context, without re-verdicting a mechanism that belongs to a different unit.
guards.maps_to: ChainsOfBindingPower.AfterCardDrawn (ChainsOfBindingPower.cs:38-46) afflicts a just-drawn card with Bound while a per-turn budget (base.Amount, counted via CardAfflictedEntry history) is unspent; BeforeCardPlayed (:48-56) latches a per-play flag so ShouldPlay (:68-78) can refuse a SECOND Bound card the same turn; BeforeSideTurnEnd (:86-94) resets the flag and unconditionally clears Bound off every card in `PlayerCombatState.AllCards`. Mirrored in the sim by `power/chains_of_binding` (powers.py's ChainsOfBindingPower class), already audited: rollup verdict `gap`, two entries — a dropped enemy-turn-side guard on AfterCardDrawn and a wrong-slot BeforeCardPlayed write — both labelled DORMANT there. Not re-derived or duplicated here; this affliction's OWN overrides (none beyond HasExtraCardText) are unaffected by either finding.

Bound overrides no `IsStackable`, so it inherits AfflictionModel's default `False` (AfflictionModel.cs:127-130) — a card already carrying any affliction (Bound or otherwise) cannot be re-Bound. `BoundAffliction` (afflictions.py) likewise leaves the base `Affliction.is_stackable = False` unoverridden.

Bound is applied only to cards in `base.Owner.Player`'s hand/piles (ChainsOfBindingPower.cs:39) — the game has no monster deck, so every ported affliction (all seven) is a card-marker that in practice always lands on the PLAYER's own cards, never a creature directly. ChainsOfBindingPower is carried BY the player (an enemy-inflicted debuff on the player, applied by the Queen — `sts2_rl/monsters/glory/queen.py`, confirmed ported), so there is no "applier death" removal case the way Hexed has one: BeforeSideTurnEnd sweeps every Bound card unconditionally at the end of the side turn the power sits on, regardless of whether the power itself survives, so Bound never persists past the turn it was granted in. No AfterDeath override exists on ChainsOfBindingPower; if the PLAYER dies the run/combat ends before the question can matter, and if an ENEMY dies, ChainsOfBindingPower (owned by the player) is unaffected either way.
